title: LazyPock backup / import payload
description: Full-database backup format accepted by POST /api/import and the Studio (Settings → Import / Backups). Generate this shape with GET /api/export. Documented at https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/backup
$comment: The importer also accepts a bare array of collection objects, and PocketBase 23+ collections that use a top-level "fields" key with flat type options (see the docs page). This schema describes the canonical LazyPock export envelope.

collections.description: Every collection to create/update, with its records.

id.description: Existing collection id. Omit it and the collection is matched by name.

name.description: Table name: starts with a letter, lowercase letters/numbers/underscores only.

type.description: base = plain records; auth = accounts with email + write-only password; view = a read-only collection over a SQL query.

schema.description: Field definitions. PocketBase exports call this "fields" instead — send either, and if both are present "fields" wins.

options.description: Collection-level options: indexes for a table, or the query for a view.

indexes.description: Custom indexes, as expressions ("UNIQUE email", "created_at DESC, id") or a full PocketBase `CREATE INDEX ...` statement. Only the collection's own columns, and only plain columns (no expressions). Not for a view collection.

viewQuery.description: PocketBase's spelling of a view's SQL; folded into options.view_query.

viewBuilder.description: The no-code view spec; rendered to SQL and stored as options.view_query.

records.description: Records to upsert by id. A view carries none: its rows are its query's.

name.description: Field name. Kept verbatim (case preserved); it is also the API key and DB column name.

hidden.description: Never returned in API responses / not shown in the Studio.

system.description: System-managed field. Fields with system=true are stripped on import (e.g. PocketBase's own "id" field) — do not include them.

default.description: Default value applied when the field is omitted on write.

options.description: Type-specific settings, e.g. { "maxSelect": 3 } for a multi select, { "values": [...] } for select, { "collection": "other" } for relation, { "onCreate": true } for autodate.

rules.description: PocketBase filter rules. null = superusers only; "" = public.
